paras: Upgrade your BMW or Toyota GR Supra front braking performance with Dixcel brake pads, engineered in Japan and developed through decades of OEM supply and motorsport experience. Dixcel pads are designed to deliver consistent braking performance, stable pedal feel, and reliable control for daily driving through to more spirited use.

This listing covers an extensive range of modern BMW models. Highlights include the M340i xDrive (G20/G21) , M240i xDrive (G42) , M440i xDrive (G22/G23/G26) , X3 M40i and M40d (G01) , X4 M40i (G02) and Z4 M40i (G29) , along with the 3 Series (G20/G21) , 4 Series (G22/G23/G26) , 5 Series (G30/G31) , 6 Series Gran Turismo (G32) , 7 Series (G11/G12) , X3 (G01) , X4 (G02) , X7 (G07) and the electric i4 (G26) and iX (I20) . It also fits the Alpina XD3 (G01) and the Toyota GR Supra (J29/A90) .
